snippet.title: Windwoven – Teaser Trailer Now Released
snippet.description:
You’ve inherited a patch of untamed land at the edge of the town’s forest.
Spend your days tilling the soil with your hoe, planting radishes, raising chicks, and forging bonds with the quirky neighbors in town. Seeds sown in spring blossom into lush gardens by summer. Come autumn, gather around a bonfire to roast pumpkins while listening to the storyteller’s tales of secrets deep in the woods. At night, lie beneath the shade of trees as fireflies twinkle like a galaxy under the stars—this is your idyllic rural life.

Windwoven - The Steam Page Now Live!

We look forward to meeting you in Windblown Land, where the breeze carries your tales.
